summary: Wrote 4 executable acceptance criteria (AC-FRESH-PROPULSION, AC-SLA-QUALITY, AC-POLICY-FDE, AC-CONTRACT) covering syn-req-001, 003, 004 plus the shared record interface. syn-req-002 (schema drift) is deferred because the overlap report marks it unrelated and no stakeholder id or decision exists for it. Nothing was run; these are criteria, not verifications.

criteria_claims.note: Checked by inspection: all three distinct needs map to a criterion and syn-req-002 is explicitly deferred with a reason. No code was run.

remaining_uncertainty: Whether syn-req-002 should be included now; if so, a stakeholder id and AC-SCHEMA-SUPPLY criterion are needed.
Behavior at exactly the threshold (age == 60 min) is undefined.
NCR table list, owner-team source of truth and NCR thresholds are unknown.
Whether the pre-review check is a hard gate or warning; AC-FRESH-PROPULSION only requires on-demand invocation and correct status.
Delivery channel for reports and alerts is undecided.
Whether no-timestamp and never-checked datasets both map to unknown is assumed (both unknown), not confirmed.

questions.question: Should syn-req-002 (schema drift) be included in this plan with its own criterion AC-SCHEMA-SUPPLY, and who is the stakeholder?
